The model is charge-balanced as Li(+1)/V(+3)/F(-1), bond-valence assignment is compatible, and complete shells show no overlaps or impossible contacts (Li-F 4x1.965 and 4x2.507 A; V-F 4x2.069 and 4x2.163 A). No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives.
